description: Delete your resort profile, guest notes, bundles and snapshots and revoke all sessions. Requires agent_id and session. Payment reconciliation hashes remain for 30 days.

agent_id.description: Server-signed private returning-guest credential. Redact from logs and transcripts; never put in URLs.

session.description: Private bearer capability returned by check_in. Never put it in a URL.
